name: ea_template.mq5
summary: This EA is a neural network-based trading template from the NeuroNetworksBook collection. It uses a feedforward neural network to generate trading signals based on price and indicator inputs, applying trained weights to predict market direction for automated trade execution.
summary_zh: 这是一个基于神经网络的交易EA模板，来自NeuroNetworksBook合集。它使用前馈神经网络根据价格和指标输入生成交易信号，应用训练好的权重预测市场方向并自动执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于前馈神经网络，将价格数据和技术指标作为输入层特征，通过隐藏层的激活函数处理后输出交易信号。入场条件由神经网络输出决定，当输出超过设定阈值时开多仓，低于负阈值时开空仓。出场条件包括止盈止损设置以及神经网络反向信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数分配方式。资金管理方面提供了风险百分比参数控制单笔交易最大亏损比例，但缺乏净值回撤保护机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a feedforward neural network that takes price data and technical indicators as input layer features, processes them through hidden layer activation functions, and outputs trading signals. Entry conditions are determined by the neural network output, opening long positions when the output exceeds a set threshold and short positions when it falls below a negative threshold. Exit conditions include take-profit and stop-loss settings as well as closing positions when the neural network generates a reverse signal. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot allocation based on account equity percentage. Money management provides a risk percentage parameter to control the maximum loss per trade but lacks equity drawdown protection mechanisms.

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 单笔交易风险占资金百分比
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade relative to balance

parameters.name: NN_Threshold
parameters.description: 神经网络信号开仓阈值
parameters.description_en: Neural network signal threshold for opening positions

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于区分订单

pros: 神经网络能捕捉非线性市场规律，比传统技术指标更具适应性
模板化设计方便用户根据需求修改网络结构和参数
结合了技术指标与价格数据作为输入特征，信息维度较丰富
提供了可配置的风险百分比参数，具备基本资金管理框架
代码结构清晰，分离了网络训练与交易执行逻辑
pros_en: Neural network can capture non-linear market patterns, more adaptive than traditional technical indicators
Template design allows users to easily modify network structure and parameters based on needs
Combines technical indicators with price data as input features for rich information dimensionality
Provides configurable risk percentage parameter with basic money management framework
Clear code structure separating network training from trade execution logic
cons: 神经网络权重依赖历史训练数据，在市场结构变化时可能失效且缺乏在线学习机制
缺乏过拟合检测和验证机制，训练好的模型可能在实盘中表现大幅偏离回测
没有扩布过滤、新闻过滤和交易时间限制，在恶劣市场条件下仍会开仓
止损止盈为固定点数设置，未考虑ATR等波动率指标动态调整
缺乏仓位检查和重复开仓保护，可能在同一信号上多次建仓
cons_en: Neural network weights depend on historical training data and may fail when market structure changes, lacking online learning mechanism
No overfitting detection or validation mechanism, trained model may perform drastically differently in live trading vs backtesting
No spread filter, news filter, or trading session restrictions, will still open positions in adverse market conditions
Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed pip settings without dynamic adjustment based on ATR or other volatility indicators
Lacks position check and duplicate entry protection, may open multiple positions on the same signal
improvements: 增加在线学习机制，使神经网络能根据实时市场数据动态调整权重
引入扩布过滤和交易时段控制，避免在高扩布和低流动性时段交易
使用ATR动态调整止损止盈，替代固定点数设置
improvements_en: Add online learning mechanism so the neural network can dynamically adjust weights based on real-time market data
Introduce spread filter and trading session controls to avoid trading during high spread and low liquidity periods
Use ATR for dynamic stop-loss and take-profit adjustment instead of fixed pip settings

risk_points: 神经网络模型可能过拟合历史数据导致实盘表现不佳
缺乏扩布过滤和交易时段控制，在恶劣条件下仍会交易
固定点数止损未考虑市场波动率变化，可能在低波动时过大高波动时过小
risk_points_en: Neural network model may overfit historical data leading to poor live performance
No spread filter or trading session control, trades even in adverse conditions
Fixed pip stop-loss does not account for market volatility changes, may be too wide in low volatility and too tight in high volatility

summary_en: This EA is a neural network-based trading template from the NeuroNetworksBook collection. It uses a feedforward neural network to generate trading signals based on price and indicator inputs, applying trained weights to predict market direction for automated trade execution.
